name: internetless-reading-v1-gates-2-3-20261009
description: GATES 2+3 BUILT & VERIFIED (Oct 9 2026): corpus /api/doc read route (v0.2.9), browser local-first doc reader with IndexedDB cache + honest LIVE/OFFLINE/PREVIEW labels, search 'stored' link with frozen ranking laws proven untouched. content:
{
  "mission": "HARZ Internetless Reading v1 \u2014 GATE 2 (full-document storage read path) + GATE 3 (search-to-browser wiring), approved by Rabiu Oct 9 2026 with corrections (his search node holds 32,945+ docs on his account; harz-offline-browser republished on his account; one-library ruling: doc route is wiring, Reader remains the crown).",
  "gate2_corpus_v029": "corpus worker v0.2.9 adds /api/doc \u2014 key-gated (WAVE_KEY), by id or content_hash, returns full text + identity + source + size. Verified live: doc id 1055000 returns 14,424 chars (Gutenberg, The Great Stone of Sardis part 4), identical by hash, honest 404 not-found, 400 bad-params, 401 without key. All existing routes regression-clean (stats 1055189, export 200, pull.sh sha unchanged 07f3373c).",
  "gate3_browser_v3": "harz-browser adds /doc (local-first reader page: IndexedDB cache by content_hash/id/sid, honest labels LIVE/CACHED/OFFLINE/PREVIEW/MISSING/NO-NET, >200k char display cap honestly labeled, light theme #f0f2f5) and /doc-data (server-side resolver: sid -> search /document/<id> via B_HARZ_SEARCH service binding -> corpus /api/doc via new B_HARZ_CORPUS service binding; wave key never reaches the client). Fixes en route: Cloudflare error 1042 (workers.dev-to-workers.dev fetch blocked within account) resolved via service bindings; template-literal regex escape bug fixed and verified in served HTML.",
  "gate3_search_link": "harz-search result renderer adds 'stored' link -> https://harz-browser.harz.workers.dev/doc?sid=<id>. Frozen ranking laws untouched: benchmark q=energy/token/harz top-10 ids+scores and totals identical pre/post patch (552/242/461).",
  "browser_verification": "Browserbase real-browser render PASSED: /doc?id=1055000 renders full 14,424-char article with LIVE badge and 'saved on device'; restart test (navigate away, return) renders again from device store; /doc?sid=0 (old index, not in corpus) renders honest PREVIEW: 2,000-char snippet + 'not in the corpus yet' note + 'Open original (needs internet)'. Screenshot captured. Honest pending labels: flight-mode OFFLINE test and Infinix-viewport test are owner-side (GATE 4 phone runbook issued); the old index (11,365 docs, Sep 20) has zero hash overlap with this corpus so its results open as honest previews until his node's hash-linked docs are wired the same way.",
  "gate4_runbook": "Test article: https://harz-browser.harz.workers.dev/doc?id=1055000 (14,424 chars > 6,000 requirement). Steps: open online, verify LIVE + saved; airplane mode; reopen same URL, verify OFFLINE badge + full text (beginning/middle/end); restart browser offline; repeat; then any search result -> stored link."
